description: This file contains unit tests for relational database storage operations, including streaming data tests, cancellation tests, and base class setup for database testing using xUnit framework.

classes.name: StreamingTest
classes.description: Data model class for streaming tests, containing an ID and byte array for stream data.

classes.name: RelationalStoreTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup and utility methods for relational storage testing, including stream insertion, reading, and cancellation testing.

methods.name: InsertAndReadStreamsAndCheckMatch
methods.description: Runs parallel tasks to insert byte streams into the database and verify data integrity by reading back.

methods.name: InsertIntoDatabaseUsingStream
methods.description: Inserts a byte array into the database as a stream, associating it with a stream ID.

methods.name: ReadFromDatabaseUsingAsyncStream
methods.description: Reads a byte stream from the database asynchronously, returning a StreamingTest object.

methods.name: CancellationTokenTest
methods.description: Performs a cancellation test on database read operations with a specified timeout.
